title_en: Graduation Thesis Submission for Undergraduates Graduating in February 2027
summary: Undergraduate students who have applied to graduate in February 2027 as a primary major or double major (including the Faculty of Liberal Studies) must submit a graduation thesis to the department administrative office in Building 301, Room 319. Submissions are accepted from December 2026 and are due by Monday, 21 December 2026. Students who cannot meet this deadline must submit a Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form by 21 December 2026 and then submit the thesis by Monday, 28 December 2026.
applies_to: Mandatory for undergraduate (bachelor's) students who have applied to graduate in February 2027 and are primary majors or double majors in the department, including students of the Faculty of Liberal Studies (자유전공학부). This includes students who previously submitted a report when completing the graduation project. Students who are not graduating may not submit a thesis.

translation:
Graduation Thesis Submission for Bachelor's Students Expected to Graduate in February 2027

1. Students expected to graduate in February 2027 should refer to the attached Graduation Thesis Writing Guidelines and submit their graduation thesis to the department administrative office (학부 행정실) by the deadline.
(1) Who must submit: Among students who have applied to graduate in February 2027, primary majors and double majors (including the Faculty of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부]).
※ A student may not submit only a graduation thesis without graduating.
(2) Graduation thesis submission deadline: by Monday, 21 December 2026.
* Even if your thesis has already been written, do not submit it early; please submit from December.
(3) Write your student ID number in pencil at the bottom of the thesis cover.
* Double majors and Faculty of Liberal Studies students should write, in pencil, 복수 (double major) or 자유 (Liberal Studies) in front of the student ID number.
(4) Separate binding is not required (the department office will bind all theses together later). Both double-sided and single-sided printing are acceptable. (However, the outer cover and the approval page must each be printed single-sided.)

2. Students who unavoidably cannot submit the graduation thesis by the deadline must submit the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form (졸업논문 제출일 확인서; form attached) by Monday, 21 December 2026 to the staff member in charge in Building 301, Room 319 (the name is given in the original notice).
(1) The thesis submission deadline under the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form is Monday, 28 December 2026.
(2) The confirmation form must be submitted by Monday, 21 December 2026, and the thesis must be submitted by Monday, 28 December.

3. How to write
(1) Outer cover: write "2027.2".
(2) Approval page (인준지): write the year, month and day on which your thesis advisor signed it.

4. Students who previously submitted a report when completing the graduation project must also write the thesis according to the attached graduation thesis format, obtain their thesis advisor's signature, and submit it.

* Inquiries: the department office (contact details are given in the original notice).
